content:
Some shameless self-promotion: @Leonardo de Moura @Jeremy Avigad @Soonho Kong @Jakob von Raumer and I received the Skolem Award for the original paper on Lean: The Lean Theorem Prover (System Description) (pdf), published at CADE-25 in 2015.

The Skolem Award is given to the CADE paper from 10 years ago that has passed the test of time, by being a most influential paper in the field.

The award will be officially given to Leo at CADE-30.

(Discussion thread)
